#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <cctype>

std::pair<int, int> documentAnalyser(const std::string& doc) {
    bool inParen = false;
    bool wasLetter = false;
    int longest = 0;
    int length = 0;
    int words = 0;
    
    for (char ch : doc) {
        if (ch == '(') {
            inParen = true;
            wasLetter = false;
            length = 0;
        } else if (ch == ')') {
            inParen = false;
            wasLetter = false;
            length = 0;
        } else if (std::isalpha(static_cast<unsigned char>(ch))) {
            if (inParen && !wasLetter) {
                words++;
            } else if (!inParen) {
                length++;
                if (length > longest) longest = length;
            }
            wasLetter = true;
        } else {
            wasLetter = false;
            length = 0;
        }
    }
    return {longest, words};
}

int main() {
    int len;
    std::cin >> len;
    std::string text;
    std::cin >> text;
    
    auto ans = documentAnalyser(text);
    std::cout << ans.first << " " << ans.second;
    
    return 0;
}
